mapper.insert: INSERT INTO maintenance (title, message_ko, message_en, start_at, end_at, status, allow_admin_access, created_by) VALUES (#{title}, #{messageKo}, #{messageEn}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'SCHEDULED'), COALESCE(#{allowAdminAccess}, true), #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, message_ko, message_en, start_at, end_at, status, allow_admin_access, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM maintenance WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, title, message_ko, message_en, start_at, end_at, status, allow_admin_access, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM maintenance ORDER BY start_at DESC

SELECT id, title, message_ko, message_en, start_at, end_at, status, allow_admin_access, created_by, created_at, updated_at FROM maintenance WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOW() BETWEEN start_at AND end_at ORDER BY start_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE maintenance SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE maintenance SET title = #{title}, message_ko = #{messageKo}, message_en = #{messageEn}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt}, allow_admin_access = #{allowAdminAccess}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE maintenance SET status = 'COMPLETED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status IN ('SCHEDULED', 'ACTIVE') AND end_at < NOW()
